title: Fix dependencies to use Pre-Depends for debconf and snapd.
commit_message:
Fix dependencies to use Pre-Depends for debconf and snapd.

Snapd must be running when the package preinst is run.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index c400e34..47bb023 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+maas (1:0.2) focal; urgency=medium
+
+  * Fix dependencies to pre-depend on debconf and snapd
+  * Fix project homepage URL to https
+
+ -- Alberto Donato <alberto.donato@canonical.com>  Thu, 20 Feb 2020 11:49:00 +0100
+
 maas (1:0.1) focal; urgency=medium
 
   * Install MAAS from the snap, migrating existing install if needed
diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index 2ff0adc..994026a 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ Priority: optional
 Maintainer: Ubuntu Developers <ubuntu-devel-discuss@lists.ubuntu.com>
 Build-Depends: debhelper (>= 10)
 Standards-Version: 4.1.3
-Homepage: http://maas.io/
+Homepage: https://maas.io/
 
 Package: maas
 Architecture: all
@@ -41,8 +41,9 @@ Replaces: bind9,
           maas-rack-controller (<< 1:0.1~),
           maas-region-api (<< 1:0.1~),
           maas-region-controller (<< 1:0.1~)
-Depends: snapd,
-         ${misc:Depends}
+Pre-Depends: debconf,
+             snapd
+Depends: ${misc:Depends}
 Description: Transitional package to the maas snap
   This is a transitional dummy package. It can be safely removed.
